jobs.prompt: Split repairs must fix the fixable errors themselves instead of parking tickets (the Needs-you inbox holds split-park items for T-0226, contracts/cluster.json, parts availability files and migration 0021). Put ALL repair logic in a NEW module tools/split-repair.mjs (pure functions over a ticket batch and the ledger, exported as repairTicketBatch({tickets, ledgerTickets, scopeText, pathExists}) returning { tickets, notes, parked }), do not edit tools/tickets.mjs or tools/ticket-paths.mjs, and call it from the split repair round in tools/scope-commands.mjs with one small hook before any ticket is parked. Automatic repairs: 1) a path a ticket owns (files) or a contract path it lists (contracts) that does not exist is never a 'missing file' park: if the path is owned by another ticket in the same ledger or batch add that ticket to dependsOn (a contract file owned by another ticket becomes a dependency, never a park); otherwise mark the path as one the ticket creates (new file, warning only), because a ticket that creates a file must declare it new; the same for context paths that another ticket creates (add the dependency instead of failing). The 'closest real path' suggestion must never replace a path the ticket intends to create. 2) Format errors are repaired automatically: a ticket with missing acceptance gets the acceptance lines of the requirements it references (scopeRefs) copied from the scope file; screens ids are normalised to kebab-case (lowercase, non-alphanumerics to a dash, trimmed) and cut to the first 5 unique ids; other trivially fixable shape errors (string instead of array for one-item lists, duplicate entries) are normalised. 3) A ticket parked as 'depends on a rejected ticket' is re-checked after its parent is repaired in the same or a later round: the dependency chain is re-evaluated until no ticket depends on a rejected one that has since been repaired; a 'depends on rejected' chain must never end in the inbox as a separate item per child (one item for the root cause only, and only if the root cause truly cannot be repaired). 4) Every repair is recorded in the split output (note lines: ticket id, rule, what changed) so the result is auditable.
